title: See the review queue behind a model score
description: Change the cohort, prevalence, and operating point. The confusion matrix and review burden update together; values are illustrative and are not clinical recommendations.

operatingPoints.label: Favor sensitivity
operatingPoints.detail: Catch more modeled positive cases while sending more negative cases to review.

operatingPoints.label: Balanced example
operatingPoints.detail: Use an illustrative middle operating point to expose both error types.

operatingPoints.label: Favor specificity
operatingPoints.detail: Reduce modeled false alerts while leaving more positive cases to the ordinary pathway.
